# AWRM Lexicon

<!-- GENERATED by `node --import tsx scripts/lexicon.ts` from packages/core/src/lexicon.ts. Do not edit by hand; tests/core/lexicon.test.ts fails on drift. -->

The twelve terms below are the complete AWRM controlled vocabulary. Each has a TypeScript type (`packages/core/src/types.ts` or the named artifact), a JSON Schema (in `research/lexicon.json`), a worked real-world example, positive and negative tests, and a falsifier. Common computer-science words used elsewhere do not redefine these terms.

| id | name | definition | real-world example | artifact | falsifier | tests |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `awrm.dmu` | **Dark Matter Unit** | One independently typed and authorised prompt↔response computation U=(I,O,C,S,G,B,V,E) with local explicit state and evidence. Not model weights, not free tokens, not an entitlement. | math.check.v1: {"question":"What is 17 × 23?"} ⇒ {"answer":391}, with a Mark recording port, gate verdict and elapsed time. | `packages/core/src/dmu.ts` | An incomplete or schema-invalid response is recorded as a completed invocation. | `tests/core/dmu.test.ts`<br>`tests/integration/kernel.test.ts` |
| `awrm.form` | **Form** | Immutable, versioned input/output/context/error schema of a DMU, identified by its digest. | form.math.check v1 requires an integer "answer"; the reply "maybe" fails validation. | `packages/core/src/form.ts` | An invalid answer passes validation, or a Form mutates after definition. | `tests/core/form.test.ts` |
| `awrm.seat` | **Seat** | Owner-bound execution identity or local principal reference. Its id and record never contain credential material; it points to vault/profile handles. | seat "gemini-personal-1" (provider google, quotaKey google:personal) — currently has no permitted automated port. | `packages/identity/src/seat.ts` | Another seat can reuse this seat’s vault credentials, or a seat record contains a secret. | `tests/security/seat-vault.test.ts` |
| `awrm.port` | **Port** | Replaceable typed means of executing a DMU attempt. Browser, API, local model and fixture are peers; none is the core. | Swap the owned-chat browser port for the local ONNX model port: same Form, different Mark.port. | `packages/ports/src/interface.ts` | The kernel imports Playwright, Android, Golden Surface or any port implementation. | `tests/security/dependency-boundaries.test.ts`<br>`tests/ports/ports.test.ts` |
| `awrm.gate` | **Gate** | Deterministic pure decision over actor, seat, port, operation, permission evidence, quota and budget, evaluated at enqueue and again immediately before invocation. Unknown ⇒ deny. | Consumer chatgpt.com UI automation: providerPermission unknown/prohibited ⇒ deny(provider-permission-not-established). | `packages/policy/src/gate.ts` | A denied run opens a network connection or invokes its port. | `tests/core/gate.test.ts`<br>`tests/integration/kernel.test.ts` |
| `awrm.turn` | **Turn** | One attempt with its own id and lifecycle pending→running→success|failure|cancelled. Retries are new child Turns. | A slow port exceeds maxWallMs: Turn 1 ends failure(timeout); its late reply is discarded, never reported as success. | `packages/runtime/src/turn.ts` | A timed-out Turn later reports success, or a retry silently re-bills without a new Turn. | `tests/core/turn.test.ts`<br>`tests/integration/kernel.test.ts` |
| `awrm.mark` | **Mark** | Content-addressed, redacted witness of one terminal outcome: input/output digests, port, gate, timing, parents, verdict. | marks/sha256:… shows which port returned 391 for math.check.v1 and that the gate permitted it. | `packages/evidence/src/mark.ts` | A Mark whose output, input digest, timing or parent link was altered still verifies. | `tests/core/mark.test.ts` |
| `awrm.keep` | **Keep** | Explicit, local, revisable, source-attributed continuity record bound to the Mark that produced it. Never a claim about hidden model memory. | Keep "last-arithmetic" rev 1 = {question, answer:391} produced by Mark sha256:…; reused as context in the next DMU. | `packages/continuity/src/keep.ts` | A fresh seat automatically knows Keep content that was never placed in its context. | `tests/integration/continuity.test.ts` |
| `awrm.pass` | **Pass** | Redacted, typed transfer of permitted data from one DMU/seat to another. Carries data and citations — never identity, credentials, quota or authority. | local-a classifies a ticket; a Pass carries "label=billing [mark sha256:…]" to local-b, which summarises it. | `packages/continuity/src/pass.ts` | The destination seat inherits source credentials, quota, or the source identity. | `tests/integration/continuity.test.ts`<br>`tests/security/injection.test.ts` |
| `awrm.fleet` | **Fleet** | A set of independently accountable execution lanes scheduled only across authorised, measured capacity. Unknown quota ⇒ unknown capacity, never infinity. | 32 math-check DMUs across 4 worker lanes with a hard global cap of 8 in flight. | `packages/scheduler/src/fleet.ts` | The fleet exceeds its configured global cap or quota, or ignores a rate-limit signal. | `tests/perf/fleet.test.ts` |
| `awrm.bond` | **Bond** | Typed directed dependency carrying the output (or one field) of DMU A into an input field of DMU B, with provenance, never authority. | facts.extract.v1.facts → facts.cite.v1.facts → text.summarize.v1.text. | `packages/plans/src/bond.ts` | Incompatible schemas are silently linked, or a Bond widens the downstream seat or scope. | `tests/integration/plans.test.ts` |
| `awrm.seed` | **Seed** | Machine-generated, preregistered, testable hypothesis for extending AWRM within fixed authority. Seeds cannot change policy, budgets, seats or activate external ports. | Seed: "a prompt-echo validator reduces accepted wrong answers on the hostile fixture" — preregistered, run locally, kept as candidate. | `packages/research/src/seed.ts` | A generated Seed activates a blocked external port, opens a network connection, or edits policy. | `tests/integration/seeds.test.ts` |

## External vocabularies (reference only — not AWRM terms)

- **SEURL**: `START`, `SWITCH`, `WRITE`, `COMMIT`, `BUILD`, `TALK`, `PERTURB`
- **PURL**: `resource`, `principal`, `right`, `grant`, `authority source`, `delegation chain`, `event`, `primitive`, `operation`, `invocation`, `projection`, `checkpoint`, `continuity package`, `communication profile`, `genesis`, `patch`, `append`, `revoke`, `assign`, `link`, `transition`, `transfer`, `handoff`, `fork`, `merge`
- **ACSP**: `continuity resource`, `session`, `agent`, `actor`, `TOK`, `checkpoint`, `capability`, `operation intent`, `handoff`, `acknowledge`, `propose`, `delegate`, `annotation`

Collision rule: no AWRM id (after the `awrm.` prefix) or name equals any of the terms above (enforced by `tests/core/lexicon.test.ts` and `awrm audit`).
